headline: Guest Bathroom Remodeling Mistakes That Inflate Budgets and Fail Inspections
articleBody:
Renovating a guest bathroom involves more than picking nice tile. Here are common slip-ups homeowners encounter and how to avoid them during your project.

Common Mistakes to Avoid:
1. Starting demolition without permits: Moving supply lines or wiring without required permits can stall work and complicate future property sales. Check municipal requirements before swinging a hammer.
2. Skipping a subfloor check: Laying heavy floor tile over compromised wood or an uneven base leads to cracked grout. Always inspect the framing once old layers are stripped away.
3. Overlooking GFCI protection: Placing standard outlets near wet zones fails safety standards. Ensure all bathroom receptacles have proper GFCI protection on a dedicated circuit.
4. Venting moisture into the attic: Dumping humid air into ceiling cavities breeds mold. Always duct exhaust fans entirely to the building exterior.
5. Inadequate shower waterproofing: Relying solely on cement board without a dedicated waterproofing system risks slow leaks behind walls. Install tested moisture barriers before setting tile.
